title: Retire the legacy marketing distribution, stack and buckets
description:
Part of story chatticus-e50451 (group G2). Legacy ChatticusMarketing stack (distribution with no aliases, site bucket, CloudFront functions), two retained marketing buckets, and the marketing deploy role. Steps: disable the distribution for 7 days (requests were seen on 2026-10-21 and 2026-10-24 UTC, about 77 per day, unexplained and likely scanners), delete the stack before the DNS stack (it imports the zone id and certificate), empty and delete retained buckets, delete the marketing deploy role stack after confirming the website repo uses the Chatticus account role. Rollback: re-enable the distribution.

Feature: Legacy marketing retired
  Scenario: Live site keeps serving
    Given the legacy distribution was disabled for 7 days
    When the legacy stack and buckets are deleted
    Then chattic.us and www keep serving from the Chatticus account

comments.author: home
comments.text: Legacy marketing distribution E2KIMGDJ4DW3XZ disabled 2026-10-26 at 14:03 UTC, status Deployed at 14:05 UTC. Aliases: none. Config backup (no secrets) saved in the local backup folder as cloudfront-legacy-E2KIMGDJ4DW3XZ-config-backup-20261026.json. Verified chattic.us, www.chattic.us and hey.chattic.us return 200 after the change. Do not delete anything before 2026-11-02 (7 days). Re-enable: get-distribution-config for the id, set Enabled true, update-distribution with the ETag (the backup file holds the original config) in the legacy account.
